title: Issues experienced by G6 Firefly users
body:
#### Your environment xDrip: May 21, 2021 Android: any
#### Expected behavior No confusing, misleading, or unexpected logs, messages, menu options, or behavior
#### The following is a list of issues that could be observed by a G6 Firefly user. - [x] 1- Temperature is not shown on the system status page. https://github.com/NightscoutFoundation/xDrip/pull/1722 - [x] 2- Add Calibration is not an option. There is only an initial calibration option. https://github.com/NightscoutFoundation/xDrip/pull/1727 - [x] 3- The following message is observed after a calibration. Got invalid impossible slope calibration! - [ ] 4- Multiple instances of the following log are observed after a calibration. Received backfill packet out of sequence - [x] 5- Pop-up option to hard reset transmitter even though a Firefly cannot be reset - [ ] 6- Failure to start sensor - [ ] 7- The following message after calibrating using the treatment menu. Cannot send calibration older than 1 hour. #### Summary None of these issues is critical. They can all be circumvented, or safely ignored. However, for an inexperienced user, these can be very confusing or time consuming.
#### Steps to reproduce the behavior: Use a Firefly G6, meaning a G6 transmitter with a firmware starting with 2.18 or 2.27.
#### There are open or closed issues related to some of these: https://github.com/NightscoutFoundation/xDrip/issues/1239 https://github.com/NightscoutFoundation/xDrip/issues/1415 https://github.com/NightscoutFoundation/xDrip/issues/1310
#### Plan I would like to address all of these. However, it may take time. We have to ensure nothing is affected negatively before any fix is accepted.
